text:
Thank you so much, Sophie.
I look forward to your next request as well.

Thank you so much, Sophie!
What will you give me next?

Thank you for all these wonderful gifts.
I'm looking forward to the main Linde Festival!

While I'm happy you're so dedicated to your studies, don't overdo it.
I want to spend the day having fun with Sophie.

When Sophie is working hard thinking of me,
I'm thinking of Sophie too.

This time I spend together with Sophie...
I'll treasure every moment of it.

This is really wonderful!
You've grown so much, Sophie.

This is...! It's amazing, Sophie!
As your mentor, I'm so proud.

Good work, Sophie.
Did you find everything you were looking for?

You've brought me a gift.
What are you going to show me?

Thank you, Ryza.
I'll be counting on you next time too.

Thank you, Ryza!
I can't wait to see what you'll give me next!

Thank you for all of these.
They're all wonderful! As expected of Ryza!

Ryza, aren't you tired? Let's take a break.
I have some special tea and snacks saved up.

When I'm working together with Ryza, everything is so much fun,
and feels really special.

To me, Ryza is my one and only precious best friend.
Let's stay together forever and ever!

This is really amazing!
As expected of Ryza!

To think you could prepare something this wonderful...!
You're amazing, Ryza!

Good work, Ryza.
How are you holding up?

Ah, Ryza!
What are you going to show me next?
